_comment: Canonical character names for Interstellar (2014). English source, English narration. Use these exact strings in shots.json chars[]. 'names' is the key the linter reads (includes place/craft/concept nouns the narration will use + the channel brand). NOTE: Whisper (small) badly garbled most proper nouns in this film - see 'aliases' for the transcription drift so any beat referencing e.g. 'Fran'/'Brian' = a Brand, 'Dars'/'guitars' = TARS. Murph appears as a CHILD (young Murph) and an ADULT (adult Murph) - both are the same character string 'Murph'; disambiguate by role in shots.json action text, not by name.

roles.Cooper: ex-NASA pilot turned corn farmer; the protagonist; pilots the Endurance mission
roles.Murph: Cooper's daughter - seen as a 10-year-old girl (young Murph) and as an adult NASA scientist (adult Murph); solves the gravity equation
roles.Tom: Cooper's son; stays on the failing farm and raises a family there
roles.Amelia Brand: NASA scientist and the mission's biologist; Professor Brand's daughter; loves Wolf Edmunds
roles.Professor Brand: the elder scientist leading NASA's secret program; author of the gravity equation; hides that Plan A is a lie
roles.TARS: a witty former-Marine robot with adjustable humor/honesty settings; crews the mission with Cooper
roles.CASE: the second mission robot; calm, literal; pilots and rescues alongside Amelia
roles.KIPP: Dr. Mann's robot on the ice planet; booby-trapped, its detonation kills Romilly
roles.Mann: Dr. Mann - 'the best of us' Lazarus astronaut, found alive on the ice planet; faked his data and betrays the crew
roles.Doyle: mission crew member; killed by the giant wave on Miller's water planet
roles.Romilly: mission physicist; waits aboard the Endurance and ages 23 years; later killed by KIPP's explosion
roles.Donald: Cooper's father-in-law (the children's grandfather); runs the farm
roles.Getty: adult Murph's NASA colleague and ally on Earth in the third act
roles.Edmunds: Wolf Edmunds - the Lazarus astronaut on the third candidate planet (Plan B), Amelia's love
